periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, angling downwards and outwards from the medial to the lateral canthus.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: High vertical-to-horizontal aspect ratio, manifesting as a vertically elongated oval or teardrop shape.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced inferior tapering where the majority of the black pigment is concentrated below the ocular midline.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, shallow U-shaped curvature on the posterior boundary of the dark transverse band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick band covering approximately one-quarter of the longitudinal axis of the visible torso.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Significant gap between pinnae, separated by the white fur of the dorsal cranial surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct horizontal linear furrow or indentation is visible across the mid-frontal region of the cranium.
